units.source_text: “这个嘛，也做过各种研究的嘛……

en.t: Well, you know, I have done all kinds of research too...

units.source_text: 也试过落花生那一类球根作物的栽培……

en.t: I have also tried cultivating bulb crops, things like peanuts...

units.source_text: 还有郁金香花，简直想送来让你瞧瞧呢……”

en.t: And tulip flowers too, I almost wanted to send some over for you to see...
